newsitem.title: ALBANIA: First plane out of Tirana for week takes off.
newsitem.headline: First plane out of Tirana for week takes off.

text.p: The first plane to leave from Tirana airport since it was closed by armed unrest a week ago took off for Sofia on Thursday.
The Albanian Airlines plane with some 30 passengers of various nationalities took off only hours after airport authorities declared that it was back in normal operation.
A manager for Albanian Airlines said the airline would resume scheduled flights on Friday to Rome and Bologna, and on Saturday to Istanbul.
However Western airlines have said they do not plan to resume flights until Sunday at the earliest.

Rinas airport, some 25 km (16 miles) west of Tirana, is Albania's main gateway to the outside world and staging point for humanitarian aid that is likely to be needed soon by the troubled Balkan country.
